text: I wish there was a tool that finds out who has been using my work laptop at home and what they did, from last month's logs.
I wish there was a tool that converts a JSON array of ISO-8601 timestamps to a single UTC-normalised CSV with one column per day.
I wish there was a tool that watches a directory for new .mp4 files and transcodes them to AV1 in the background.
I wish there was a tool that can tell me which of these 300 second-hand bikes in the classifieds is stolen, from the serial numbers.
I wish there was a tool that tells me whether the drum bearing on my 2013 Bosch washing machine is worn, from the noise it makes.
I wish there was a tool that finds the recording of a 1994 local council planning meeting that mentioned my street, and names it.
I wish there was a tool that extracts every table from a PDF annual report into clean CSV with the page numbers kept.
I wish there was a tool that tells me the structural condition of the house I am bidding on from the photographs the estate agent took.
I wish there was a tool that checks a Kubernetes manifest against the cluster's actual admission webhooks and reports what would be rejected.
I wish there was a tool that renames every photo in a folder to its EXIF DateTimeOriginal, numbered per day.
I wish there was a tool that works out why my car insurance renewal jumped 40% this year, from the insurer's own internal file.
I wish there was a tool that decides my tax return for the 2023 tax year for a freelancer in three countries with crypto income.
I wish there was a tool that turns a messy CSV of addresses into a geocoded list with the coordinates in a new column.
I wish there was a tool that knows which of my mother's old knives are the good ones, from photographs of the blades.
I wish there was a tool that diffs two SQL schemas and emits the ALTER TABLE statements to migrate one to the other.
I wish there was a tool that finds every place in a git history where a function's behaviour changed, and writes the before/after examples.
I wish there was a tool that finds my grandmother's will in a county record office that stopped publishing its index in 1998.
I wish there was a tool that takes a long YouTube URL list and writes an RSS feed of their metadata without downloading the video.
I wish there was a tool that predicts my toddler's sleep schedule from her own last three weeks of handwritten logs.
I wish there was a tool that turns a chess PGN file into a clickable board replay in a static HTML page.
